svg.title: Laboratory inputs, summaries and review output
svg.desc: CSV / LIS / CDS Hub DB; Complete FHIR documents; D · Laboratory Observation; Laboratory semantic set; Supplied aggregate statistics; Choose output representation; Laboratory checks → CSV + HTML with sources; Clinician review of the complete set

g.text: CSV / LIS / CDS Hub DB
Individual or distinct source rows
Column map + actual source counts
Read-only site-specific view
Complete FHIR documents
Bundle / array / NDJSON / JSON
or resource_json in a CSV cell
Preserve every reference context
D · Laboratory Observation
MII guide or base FHIR R4
Explicit mapping and editions
TOML; secrets in separate files
Laboratory semantic set
code + system/edition + analyte/name
value or observed bounds + unit/system
Every reference range and its qualifiers
Specimen, method, comparator and modifiers
Supplied aggregate statistics
Same laboratory semantic context as the source set
Count + mean + sample SD + minimum + maximum
Each statistic has its declared measurement unit
Pool only disjoint groups with sufficient information
Choose output representation
distinct: complete guarded sets + known counts; laboratory numeric distributions
items: individual inputs with original resource/database ID and source locator
Missing counts and unresolved references remain explicit; no missing context is invented
Laboratory checks → CSV + HTML with sources
Lookups, code–unit–context fit; optional local AI and literature evidence
Study CSV: quotations, statistic roles, units, sources and extraction failures
Clinician review of the complete set
Each source set → linked definitions → explanations, transformations and sources
FHIR validation is separate and applies only to full resources; input stays unchanged
Terminology validity, numerical readiness and clinical correctness stay separate
